items.text: Save games
Further camera improvements

Unique spawn rooms for all 5 days
We’ve added a save system! We wanted to give you a breakdown to see how it works in real time as you are playing:
You get one save slot per host
When hosting, you can load your save or start fresh
Starting a new run won’t overwrite your save until you return to the swamp (win or lose)
No saves in matchmaking
Only the host saves (clients don’t keep progress)
Daily Challenge & Custom Seeds don’t save (keeps things clean and consistent)
What about items and buffs? We don’t restore exact inventories (your squad might change), so instead everything gets converted into coins - items, buffs the lot!

[p align="start"]Hey Frog Sqwad 🐸,
[p align="start"]It’s been a busy week over at Panic Stations HQ! We’ve been working hard to gather and act on as much feedback as possible.

[p align="start"]We’ve seen a lot of players, both in reviews and on social media, struggling with some of Frog Sqwad’s mechanics. What we’ve realised is that things we now do as muscle memory aren’t signposted very well in-game. So today, you’ll see a new tutorial to help you jump in and learn some of the most important mechanics!
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45890234/bab8570e02e50a18c917ace2844bd974a0e03651.png"]
On top of this, we’ve also added tooltips during gameplay to make things a bit clearer.
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45890234/455c65c6e4bb7ba89a733423d689ffd87130e865.png"]

[p align="start"]We’ve also seen some players disappointed with the lack of tongue functionality, and more importantly, a big request for a tongue reel feature. So we’ve added that too! Your little frog can now use its tongue to move up and down in sewers, helping with puzzles and overall movement.
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45890234/69624328a7913621039729a8c76b01afb3235ea1.png"]For keyboard: R - Reel In, T - Reel out.
For controller: Trigger - Reel In, Bumper - Reel Out

[p align="start"]We also felt that the Swamp King was a bit stingy on day one. We want to encourage players to get their hands on items and experiment with mechanics earlier, so you’ll now receive 400 coins when you first hop in!
[p align="start"]If you’re after a quick TL;DR, here’s what’s new:
